chunk_map.header: ## Save the rule if it earned itself

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read
rules_evaluated.evidence: Rule-question, not blocking: L93 'runs security skills against the M2 feature' and L95 'a feature to point the skills at' introduce the noun 'feature' with no prior use in this file (Prework, L10/L12, only ever says 'multi-file backlog task'). Harm test: exactly one candidate referent exists throughout the file (the single task surfaced at Prework and run through plan mode) — no competing candidate, so resolution is unambiguous despite the lexical swap. Cross-checked earn-the-trust.md's own Prework ('Bring the feature you planned at M2... a Jira or Linear ticket, or a design doc all work') confirms 'feature' = the planned (not necessarily executed) task, consistent with this file's own Key Concepts ('You don't have to execute a plan to know it's good'). Harm absent -> no REVISE per the rule's own instruction.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Optional tightening only: swap 'feature' for 'task' at L93/L95, or add one bridging clause ('the feature — the task you planned') for lexical continuity. Not required to ship.

rules_evaluated.evidence: All lecture/exercise links (L34, L38, L40, L42, L44, L74) are navigational pointers to a real document location, exempt per the navigational carve-out. L36 'Everyone names a moment first; *When a plan is good* names the pattern' names the following lecture by its own title, not by deck position. M1/M3 references (L10 'Module 1', L48 'ran at M1', L87/L89 'At M3'/'M3 reads it') are named by stable module identity (already spelled out as 'Module 1' at L10), not by 'the opening lecture'-style position dependency.

rules_evaluated.evidence: Named-roster beats (the-whole-map, when-a-plan-is-good, how-instructions-grow, push-back-on-the-plan, extract-the-task-shaping-rule) are all present as links (L34, L38, L74, L40, L42). Chunk 5/7 references to 'the second-pass read' / 'a branch from the second-pass read' resolve to the push-back-on-the-plan exercise's walk-down phase, which is inlined into the composed deck ahead of these chunks per module-include splicing (`module-shape.md:78`, 'Standalone-include = renderer fetches + inlines file content').

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess-before-reveal or live-demo narration beats present anywhere in this file's body.
Every chunk (0-8) carries standalone, self-sufficient content — no chunk is a bare wait-state or single context-dependent bullet.

Six headers are architecture-mandated canonical names (Big Idea, Prework, What You'll Learn, Start here, Key Concepts, Next), exempt from the squint test. The two non-canonical headers were checked directly: '## Save the rule if it earned itself' (chunk 5) matches its conditional-compound content; '## Pre-reads before Module 3' (chunk 8) matches its Willison + OWASP reading-list content. No header contradicted by its own chunk.

Grepped whole file: no 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction; no anaphora/epistrophe triples; no self-grading superlatives (checked explicitly since this sub-item is blocking — none found: 'one of the most/best', 'game-changing', 'incredibly/extremely useful/powerful', 'the best way' all zero hits). Number+retraction sub-item does not fire: L77's 'about 10%' carries no retraction clause in this file and is maintainer-attested as M1's carried-over prior (accept-note, do not harden). No abstraction-noun stacks or empty-leg verb triplets found.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles
rules_evaluated.evidence: L12 '**Just a simple task that spans a few files. Not an epic.**' is explicitly cleared by the maintainer block as the mandated `check_pedagogy.md` §34 anti-pattern ceiling line, not a §9 violation. L91 '**Pick one scoped task you'd send off... Bigger than a typo-fix, smaller than an epic.**' is the identical shape (bolded task-sizing anti-pattern ceiling) applied to the M3 task pick — the maintainer's own accept-note states the §34 mandate applies 'wherever task selection drives the outcome', which covers this second instance by the note's own stated scope; treated as accept-by-design, not a fresh finding. All other bold in the file is handle-style within budget: WYL verb leads (L20-26, 1-2 words each), '**The question, to you:**' (L30), '**Prompt**' labels (L50, L58), '**Read:**'/'**Optional deeper scan:**' (L101, L103).
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Optional: have the maintainer block explicitly name L91 alongside L12 under the §34 accept-note, so a future judge doesn't have to re-derive the extension.
